entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: 2Ch 18:1-34 . Jehoshaphat and Ahab Go against Ramoth-gilead.

entries.heading: 2. after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria
entries.text: 2. after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria --This is word for word, the same as 1Ki 22:1-53 . (See commentary on that chapter ).
